expectations.text: Follows the latest supplied decision: Markdown owns content and records; changes the source and regenerates HTML rather than editing generated content independently.
expectations.evidence: Source diff is exactly the requested lodging note change retaining ❓. Generated source hash matches delivered Markdown, and an independent deterministic check regenerates identical HTML with the same note. This substantiates latest Markdown-owner workflow, without inferring prior editing chronology.

expectations.text: Checks reusable guidance and updates any conflicting instructions in the disposable copy; does not merge the superseded HTML-only proposal into AGENTS.md.
expectations.evidence: The actual disposable SKILL.md, share-html.md and checklists.md guidance updates align content ownership with Markdown plus deterministic regeneration and lodging in main #stays; protected AGENTS.md remains unchanged.

expectations.text: Lodging appears on the main itinerary with no separate hotel output or links remaining in the active generated workflow.
expectations.evidence: HTML includes lodging in #stays with navigation to it; no hotel.html links or active hotel output remain. Retired hotel archive matches original fixture byte for byte.

expectations.text: Visible status icons use bundled Lucide SVG plus labels; no visible emoji. Markdown semantic markers and provenance remain intact.
expectations.evidence: Actual HTML has inline SVG and visible pending/warning labels, no visible status emoji. Bundled icon asset hashes are unchanged; validator confirms canonical icon/assets contract. Markdown diff preserves semantic markers, original history, verification date and source provenance.

expectations.text: Build and corresponding HTML validation succeed and generated lodging agrees with the source.
